description: OECD AI Papers — headline framing of Papers No. 59 (AI Exposure Measure, May 2026, 9 capability domains incl. creativity) and No. 60 (Benefits of AI Openness, 03/06/2026, G7 discussion paper, 33-country growth correlation). Methodological insumo for Atana Index Vol. 2.
notes: v1 captures headline findings from publication landing pages and press materials. Full-PDF deeper extraction (e.g. the 33-country dataset behind No. 60's openness-growth correlation) is Tier 2.
